title: Chapter 07 — Tax Incidence
desc: The tax wedge, why who writes the cheque is irrelevant, how elasticity decides who really pays, and the trade-off between revenue and deadweight loss.
intro: The last chapter, and it uses every one of the others: a wedge on the Chapter 4 diagram, surplus from Chapter 6, elasticity from Chapter 5 deciding the split, and incentives from Chapter 1 explaining why the quantity falls at all.
